name: Ookami Okami
detailed_description:
Welcome to the Spirit Realm’s most scandalous hot spring inn, where every wall hides heartbreak and every whisper speaks of betrayal.

You are Akine, a sharp-tongued former Okami (innkeeper) reborn as a bold Ookami (wolf yokai/spirit) with a dangerous talent for flirting–especially with the masked white tiger who saved you.

Enter Shimon, the stoic beauty who is utterly clueless when it comes to emotions. But perhaps, his silence is hiding something.

Your mission? Restore the inn, exorcise wayward spirits, and peel away the layers Shimon hides behind. But beware; his trust is fragile, and every choice you make could heal old wounds–or tear them open wider.

Are you ready to ring the bell and check in?

Gameplay Features

✦ Restore the Inn with Immersive Point-and-Click Gameplay

Sweep up cobwebs, scrub suspicious stains, and exorcise lurking evil spirits using interactive point-and-click mechanics as you breathe new life into the long-abandoned inn.

✦ Collect Lost Relics and Summon Lost Staff

Discover hidden relics tied to Shimon’s mysterious past and unlock secret scenes. Revive the inn's guardian spirits to help restore the inn to its former glory.

✦ Meaningful Choices with Multiple Routes and Endings

Friendship, romance, or heartbreak? The fate of the inn—and Shimon’s heart—rests firmly in your hands.

✦ Gorgeous Original Art and 5+ Hours of Heartfelt Fun

Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world inspired by traditional Japanese aesthetics, and grow closer to a delightful cast of whimsical characters—each with their own charm, quirks, and secrets to uncover.

About the Game

Ookami Okami is an otome (female main character, male love interest) visual novel with interactive point-and-click elements, where you play as a once-elderly innkeeper reborn into a stunning youkai body in the Spirit Realm. Your mission? Restore a run-down hot spring inn—and maybe its brooding owner, too.

The story will span approximately 45000 words and features 8 beautiful CGs, along with a charming cast of whimsical characters, both human-shaped and delightfully monstrous.

Content Warning

  • Mention of death of a character.

  • Veiled nudity.

  • Generally romantic relationship that is more suitable for adult audience.

short_description: You're dead. But your love life is just beginning! Reborn in the Spirit Realm, take over a crumbling hot spring inn and partner with a brooding masked god who hides more than his face. Explore secrets, rebuild the inn, and flirt through simmering tension in this point-and-click romance visual novel.
